mechanism: Capture the architecture-fixed final RMSNorm, native-BF16 or PQ lm-head projection, greedy argmax, and diagnostic top-k once as a four-command Metal compute indirect command buffer. Retain one persistent scalar arena and replay against stable activation, weight, logit, and sampling buffer addresses.

scope.wait_count_claim: UNCHANGED: replay replaces per-token direct command encoding inside the existing one-submit final-head command buffer; it does not remove a submit or wait.

persistent_scalars: native rows and columns or the eight-u32 PQ ABI
graph_contract.dependency_ordering: The projection, argmax, and top-k commands carry explicit ICB barriers before execution.
graph_contract.trace_policy: Off and aggregate CPU-encode tracing are admitted. Split and per-dispatch GPU trace modes fail closed because commands inside an ICB cannot be timed honestly as separate direct encoders.

persistent_replay_contract.capture_key: head representation and geometry, hidden size, exact RMS epsilon bits, and all nine bound GPU addresses
persistent_replay_contract.pipeline_cache: Context-level ICB pipeline cache compiled with supportIndirectCommandBuffers=true.
persistent_replay_contract.resource_residency: Every directly bound activation, weight, parameter, logit, and sampling buffer is retained by the immutable replay graph and declared with exact read/write usage on the direct replay encoder.

regression_validation.unrelated_all_integration_compile_issue: cargo check -p hawking-core --lib --tests reaches the pre-existing eagle5_forward_parity integration without its speculate module feature; isolated affected targets and the full library compile and pass.

qualified: The fixed-shape final norm, native-BF16 or PQ lm-head, argmax, and top-k DAG can replay from one persistent real Metal ICB without changing bounded complete-token decisions or waits.
Warm native-BF16 replay is bit-exact to the direct four-dispatch graph and allocates no new Metal buffers.
Threadgroup-memory bindings and exact mixed norm/head/sampling profiler composition are first-class replay metadata rather than inferred from the outer CPU scope.
not_qualified: This final-head DAG plus the earlier expert-wave DAG are bounded fixed-shape subgraphs, not a single replayable whole-token graph or a persistent GPU causal loop.
No latency or TPS improvement is claimed; existing repository measurements still classify ICB host encoding as below the performance ship gate.
No sealed Math-Preserve token, sustained 2K/8K/32K run, TTFT, memory-pressure, swap, or thermal promotion was performed.
Sequence-length-dependent attention remains direct; no 32K over-dispatch or unmeasured dynamic-grid admission is claimed.
qualification.next_boundary: Keep both replay paths default-off. Audit compact-attention kernels for architecture-fixed grids and persistent scalar ABIs; leave every sequence-length-dependent grid direct unless a bounded dynamic-dispatch design is proven.
